read_only_probe.python:
import json, os, pathlib, urllib.parse, urllib.request
manifest = json.loads(pathlib.Path("docs/deployment/evidence/PERSONA-RETIRE-NEVER-PROVISIONED-20261128/evidence.json").read_text())
targets = manifest["hosted_acceptance"]["persona_ids"]
trading = json.loads(os.environ["PERSONA_TRADING_IDS"])
assert len(trading) == 3 and len(set(trading)) == 3
protected = ["persona-risk-officer", "persona-red-team"] + trading
assert len(set(targets + protected)) == 8
phase = os.environ.get("PERSONA_RETIRE_PROBE_PHASE", "after")
assert phase in {"before", "after"}
token = pathlib.Path(os.environ["PERSONA_ACCEPTANCE_TOKEN_FILE"]).read_text().strip()
def read(origin, route):
    request = urllib.request.Request(origin.rstrip("/") + route, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
        return json.load(response)
result = {"targets": {}, "protected": {}}
for persona_id in targets + protected:
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(persona_id, safe="")
    owner = read(os.environ["PERSONA_OWNER_URL"], "/api/personas/" + encoded)
    dto = read(os.environ["PANTHEON_BFF_URL"], "/bff/personas/" + encoded)["data"]
    row = {"lifecycle_state": owner["lifecycle_state"], "listScope": dto["listScope"],
           "ownerLifecycleState": dto["ownerLifecycleState"], "status": owner.get("status")}
    assert row["lifecycle_state"] == row["ownerLifecycleState"]
    result["targets" if persona_id in targets else "protected"][persona_id] = row
    if persona_id in targets:
        assert row["lifecycle_state"] == ("draft" if phase == "before" else "retired")
        if phase == "after":
            assert row["listScope"] == "retired"
if phase == "after":
    baseline = json.loads(pathlib.Path(os.environ["PERSONA_RETIRE_BASELINE"]).read_text())
    assert result["protected"] == baseline["protected"], "Protected persona lifecycle/scope changed"
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
